effect.en: For five turns, protects all Pokémon on the ground from major status ailments and confusion, and halves the power of incoming Dragon moves.

flavor.ko: 5턴 동안 땅에 있으면 상태 이상이 되지 않고 드래곤타입 기술의 데미지도 절반이 된다.
flavor.en: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.
